question: Does the very small total ramification of the degree-105 projection, including the etale state r=0, force a restrictive full permutation monodromy incompatible with the retained common-cover/V4 data?

parent_05u.exact_use: The local defect-splitting route is closed without singularity types; the selected next receiver is full monodromy of the near-etale degree-105 cover.

ex1_05g.exact_use: For r=0..28 the smooth normalization D has a degree-105 map f105:D->C2 with deg R105=2r, a degree-81 map f81 with deg R81=48+2r, and exact equality of pulled-back finite-etale H=(Z/2)^2 torsors f105^*Z ~= f81^*Z.

parent_05o.exact_use: The finite-etale V4 torsor has no local ramification inertia and the already-charged global consequence is the fixed-plane/exact-W/transvection pruning to residues 73,97,235.

riemann_existence.title: Riemann Surfaces
riemann_existence.author: Simon Donaldson
riemann_existence.locator: Section 4.2, Monodromy and the Riemann existence theorem, Theorem 2
riemann_existence.exact_use: A transitive permutation representation of pi_1(Y minus Delta) into S_d is realized by a connected proper holomorphic degree-d branched cover with the prescribed local monodromy.

finite_etale_galois_category.exact_use: Connected finite-etale covers are finite transitive pi_1-sets; pullback of the fixed H-cover is controlled by restriction of the corresponding pi_1 homomorphism.

universal_parity_check.universal_consequence: total ramification degree must be even
universal_parity_check.EX1_satisfies: deg R105=2r is even for all 29 states

r_positive.branch_assignment: every branch loop maps to t
r_positive.group_reason: Conjugates c^k t c^(-k) give adjacent transpositions around the 105-cycle, which generate S105.

explicit_transitive_monodromy_constructi.consequence: For every r=0..28 there is an abstract connected degree-105 holomorphic cover of the fixed genus-2 base with exactly the EX1 ramification total. Already at r=1 full S105 monodromy is compatible with only two units of ramification.

fixed_v4_pullback_connectedness.punctured_base: U=C2 minus branch locus of f105
fixed_v4_pullback_connectedness.H_monodromy: alpha:pi1(U)->H is surjective and kills puncture loops because Z->C2 is etale
fixed_v4_pullback_connectedness.conclusion: alpha(K)=H, so f105^*Z is connected for every r
fixed_v4_pullback_connectedness.scope: This is a connectivity statement only. It does not prove the exact labeled H-torsor equality f105^*Z ~= f81^*Z.

exact_common_torsor_boundary.retained_equality: f105^*Z ~= f81^*Z as H-torsors on the same D
exact_common_torsor_boundary.rule: Do not promote connectedness of both pullbacks, or the already-charged fixed-plane/transvection conditions, to equality of the full H-torsor classes.

decision.reopen_condition: Reopen the low-ramification monodromy route only with V6-specific local conjugacy classes/branch support or a theorem coupling the full degree-105 monodromy tuple to the degree-81 tuple beyond the retained H-torsor class.

next_route.selection_reason: 05V proves the degree-105 monodromy itself is completely flexible at the retained ramification totals. The remaining discrete topological information not already charged by 05O is the exact equality of the two pulled-back H-torsor classes on the same normalization D.
